'''Hara''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]] under the command of the [[Sith Saber]] [[Querdan Dei]].

==Biography==
As a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|non-force-sensitive]], she served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and deputy onboard the ''[[Cryptic Warning]]''. Hara turned on as the most likely target, and prepared to land in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. Since the adoption of the Sith proved to be correct, Hara landed near a warehouse until she was involved in a fight between Dei and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who was protecting [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]].
